notes.title: Steam Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Ninety-Six is finally released on Steam as well after being for so long an itchio-only release.

We hope you will enjoy the game, whether it's for the first time or not!

As always, we appreciate any comment, feedback or bug report. 
We're also forever grateful for the amazing people who made it possible to release Ninety-Six on Steam as well.


We wish you all a wonderful holiday season,
Best wishes,

Spongey Kitty
